channel.title: Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Massachusetts and RI Lawyers Weekly (masslawyersweekly.com)

item.title: Models who sued over use of images denied coverage
item.description: A federal judge ruled that an intellectual property exclusion in a CGL policy barred coverage for Massachusetts strip clubs sued over unauthorized use of professional models’ images.

item.title: SJC justice rejects DiZoglio’s bid for representation in legislative audit case
item.description: Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court justice denies Auditor Diana DiZoglio's motion to appoint special counsel in her bid to audit the state Legislature.

item.title: New York sues video game developer Valve, says its ‘loot boxes’ are gambling
item.description: New York's attorney general sued Valve, accusing its loot boxes of illegal gambling and risking addiction among children. The lawsuit demands fines and restitution.

item.title: Worcester pastor accused of fraud ordered into involuntary bankruptcy
item.description: A federal judge has forced a longtime Worcester pastor the state is pursuing for alleged fraud into involuntary bankruptcy.

item.title: Insurance – Cost-of-living adjustment – Disability income policy
item.description: Where a defendant insurance company issued a disability income policy to the plaintiff, a judgment in favor of the plaintiff should be reversed because the policy language establishes that the cost-of-living adjustment increases stop on the policy anniversary after an insured has turned 65.

item.title: DOJ abandons defense of orders targeting law firms
item.description: The DOJ has abandoned its appeals defending Trump’s executive orders targeting law firms, allowing sanctions to remain blocked by judges.

item.title: Judge finds jury issues in DraftKings class action
item.description: A Massachusetts Superior Court judge allowed Chapter 93A claims against DraftKings over its $1,000 deposit bonus ads to proceed to trial.

item.title: SJC hears arguments on MBTA Communities Act challenge
item.description: The Massachusetts Supreme Judicial Court heard arguments on Marshfield's claim that the MBTA Communities Act imposes costly unfunded mandates on municipalities.

item.title: Governor’s Council confirms pair of new judges
item.description: The Governor's Council confirmed Craig D. Mulcahey to District Court and LaKeshia Parker Small to Juvenile Court.

item.title: March 2026 Judicial Assignments
item.description: Schedules of judicial assignments in the Massachusetts Superior, District, Boston Municipal and Juvenile courts for March 2026.
